verdict.line: You lose the long attrition trades where his Passive (Darkness Rise) and W (Indestructible) shield snowball off your own damage; you win short Fury-powered all-ins that catch his W on cooldown, especially from level 6 on.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's kit rewards long trades: Passive (Darkness Rise) grants a damage aura and Move Speed after he lands 3 attacks or spells on you, and W (Indestructible) banks all damage he deals AND takes into a shield he pops to heal, so the longer a fight runs the more your own hits feed his sustain. Renekton can't out-attrition that shield economy, he has to out-burst it — a single Fury-fueled all-in with empowered W (three slashes, 1.5s stun, destroys his shield outright) lands more damage in one window than his W can bank. That's the whole matchup: this is a lane decided by who controls trade length, not by a kit-level edge, which is exactly why it sits at 47.4% over 705 games with an even lane shape.

theirWindow.when: his passive aura is active or W just cast
theirWindow.what: He's mid-attrition and banking damage into his W shield while the Darkness Rise aura boosts his damage and speed. Disengage, don't feed extra autos into his shield, and wait him out rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.when: Fury above 50 and his W on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in. Empowered W (Ruthless Predator) fires the 3-hit slash that shreds his shield outright and stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s — chain it with Q (Cull the Meek) for the Fury-boosted heal and E (Slice and Dice) for the armor shred to burst through before his 12-8s W comes back up.

start.why: 48.6% win rate over 704 games at 79.3% pick — the sustain and early damage let you actually trade instead of just soaking his Q poke.

boots.why: 48.4% win rate over 587 games at 72.3% pick — flat magic resist against his entirely magic damage kit, plus tenacity so his E (Death's Grasp) pull doesn't chain into a free stun-free all-in.

core.why: 54.9% win rate over 82 games as the lead item — its shield activates on the same burst window you're already looking for (Fury above 50, his W down).
Stacking armor shred compounds with your empowered E's own Armor reduction, letting your all-in window kill faster before his W refills.

runes.keystoneWhy: 50.5% win rate on this page, and it rewards exactly the play this matchup demands — landing consecutive hits on him fast enough to spike damage before his passive aura and W shield can offset it.

summoners.why: 48.1% win rate at 87.5% pick — Ignite denies his W (Indestructible) self-heal during your all-in window, which is the exact mechanic that otherwise lets him stabilize out of a losing trade.

playing.title: Only all-in above 50 Fury
playing.detail: Below that threshold your W is just a double-slash 0.75s stun with no shield-shred — save the real engage for when Reinforced W (three slashes, 1.5s stun, destroys his shield) is live.

playing.title: Punish his W cooldown, not his HP bar
playing.detail: His W (Indestructible) is on an 8-12s cooldown depending on rank — track when he last cast it and time your all-in for the window it's down, since that's when he has no shield to bank your damage into.

playing.title: Refuse the long trade
playing.detail: Every extra auto or spell he lands past the third feeds his Passive (Darkness Rise) aura and Move Speed, and every hit either of you lands feeds his W shield. Short exchanges only.

playing.title: Use empowered E to shred, not just gap-close
playing.detail: Empowered Slice and Dice's Armor reduction is what lets your Black Cleaver stacks and Eclipse burst actually punch through his build late — don't dash just to reposition.

playing.title: Play around level 6 hard
playing.detail: R (Dominus) is your first real power spike — the bonus Health and periodic Fury generation let you force an all-in you'd lose at level 5, so look for it immediately on hitting 6.

playing.title: Respect E (Death's Grasp) range near walls
playing.detail: 700 range pull can drag you into an extended fight on his terms if you're overextended near minions or terrain — don't give him a free reset into attrition mode.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1) — the trade-timing and Fury-threshold reasoning is my own tactical read, not part of the measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Use Renkton’s reinforced [W] when Mordekaiser uses his (W). Deal singular bursts of damage to prevent Mordekaiser’s (P) from staying active.
